<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows six signals in the aromatic region (≈120‑150 ppm): one at 131.87 ppm, two at 129.70 ppm, two at 129.01 ppm, and one at 129.00 ppm. This accounts for six aromatic carbon atoms, which is the typical count for a benzene ring.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
